lines: 女执事也是如此：必须端庄，
不说谗言，有节制，凡事忠心。
女執事也是如此：必須端莊，
不說讒言，有節制，凡事忠心。
Even so must their wives be grave
not slanderers
sober
faithful in all things .

controlling themselves

被接在荣耀里。

被聖靈稱義，被天使看見，
被傳於外邦，被世人信服，
被接在榮耀裏。

justified in the Spirit
seen of angels
preached unto the Gentiles
believed on in the world
received up into glory .
